scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can ^0055FFsign your name^000000 on almost any rare item you hold.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
我幾乎可以在您持有的任何稀有物品上^0055FF簽下您的名字^000000。

scripts.text: Tell me more...
scripts.translation: 告訴我更多...

scripts.text: Sign my items, please!
scripts.translation: 請給我的物品簽名！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can put your name on any slotless equipment or weapon.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
我可以在任何沒有卡槽的裝備或武器上籤下您的名字。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
For my work I accept:
 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
 ~ {3} Zeny per refine
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
收費如下：
 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
 ~ 每級精煉加收{3} Zeny

scripts.text:

 ~ {0} Zeny
 ~ {1} Zeny per refine

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
For my work I accept:
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
我的工作報酬如下：

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I work for free, but...
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
我免費幫忙，不過...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, I have 12 hungry children
and a very angry wife.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
唉，我還有12個嗷嗷待哺的孩子和一個火氣很大的老婆。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Or it was 12 angry children
and a very hungry wife...
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
還是說，是12個火氣很大的孩子和一個餓得不行的老婆...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Show me your items to sign...
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
請給我看看您要簽名的物品...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Nothing is equipped there!
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
那個部位沒有穿戴裝備！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, this item's already signed.
I would never touch a master's work.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
唉，這件物品已經有署名了。
我可不會動其他大師的作品。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
A card? Here?!
As I said before, I don't sign items with cards.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
這裡竟然有卡片？！
我說過，不給鑲嵌了卡片的物品簽名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign slotted items.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
抱歉，我不給有卡槽的物品簽名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign rental items!
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
抱歉，我不給租賃物品簽名！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I will need:
 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
Shall I sign your ^0055FF{3}^000000?
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]

 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
要在您的^0055FF{3}^000000上簽名嗎？

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Ok!
scripts.translation: 好的！

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
See you...
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
再見...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I don't work for 'thanks'.
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
光說聲“謝謝”可不能當報酬。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Where is {0}...?
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
{0}在哪裡...？

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Done!
scripts.translation:
[佩爾奇克]
完成了！
